body.p: This is a Response to the Office Action mailed April 12, 2024 (the "Office

Action"), in which a three (3) month Shortened Statutory Period for Response has been set, due to expire July 12, 2024. By way of this Response, claims 1-20 are amended. No claims are canceled and no new claims are added. No new matter has been added to the application. Claims 1-20 are pending.

Claim 7 was objected to due to an informality, for which the Exmainer proposed a re-wording to resolve. Applicant has amended claim 7 in accordance with the Examiner's suggestion and therefore requests that the objection to claim 7 be withdrawn.
Claims 1-20 were rejected under 35 USC 103 for being allegedly unpatentable over US 20230168670 (hereafter, "von Reventlow") in view of alternative embodiments described in von Reventlow.

Applicant does not acquiesce to the Examiner's rejections of claims 1-20, but in the interest of expediting allowance of the instant application Applicant has amended independent claim 1 to further distinguish from von Reventflow. Specifically, Applicant has amended the preamble of independent claim 1 to recite a method of operation of a fleet of robot; clarified that the original acts recited in original independent claim 1 are performed by a first robot in the fleet of robots; and added a further act of updating, by a second robot in the fleet of robots, a control model of the second robot, based at least in part based on the update made to the control model of the first robot, to increase a level of autonomy of the second robot. Support for these features may be found in Applicant's specification at at least paragraphs 0070 and 0121-0122. Based on the foregoing, Applicant has amended dependent claims 2-20 to clarify whether it is the first robot or the second robot that performs the various acts recited.

Applicant respectfully submits that von Reventflow does not teach or suggest all of the features of any of Applicant's amended claims 1-20, and therefore requests that the rejections of claims 1-20 under 35 USC 103 be withdrawn.
Applicant respectfully submits that the pending claims are in condition for allowance. Amendments and remarks are made to expedite prosecution of the instant
application only and are without prejudice to claims relating to the same or similar subject matter in any other patent or application, including any continuing application.
The Examiner is encouraged to contact the undersigned by e-mail or telephone to discuss the above and any other distinctions between the claims and the applied references, if desired.
